interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area where pedestrians share the road.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalks at intersections or key mid-block points to define safe crossing areas.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Move the utility pole to the furniture zone or grass buffer strip to clear the pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees in the grass buffer to provide shade and naturally calm traffic by narrowing the perceived street width.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove the parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines at the intersection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk to provide a clear, ADA-compliant walking path that is not obstructed by the tree.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune the tree and clear the brush to restore the full width of the existing walkway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Install a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and provide a physical barrier from traffic.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or speed cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds are maintained throughout the residential block.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a green buffer or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to increase physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation or Marking
interventions.description: Use high-visibility pavement markings or distinct materials across driveways to alert drivers to the presence of a pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Ensure adequate pedestrian-scale lighting is present to improve visibility during evening hours, as no luminaires are clearly visible.

interventions.title: Complete Sidewalk Network
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and personal security during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk across the driveway using consistent materials and maintaining the sidewalk level to prioritize pedestrian movement.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous and safe walking path on both sides of the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Marked crosswalks would provide designated areas for pedestrians to cross, increasing driver awareness.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate tripping hazards and improve overall street quality.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Parking Restrictions (Daylighting)
interventions.description: Prohibit parking of large vehicles near intersections or mid-block crossing points to maintain clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Ensure the pedestrian clear zone is maintained by removing large objects like dumpsters from the walkway.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Installation of speed cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install concrete curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all four corners of the intersection to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Install Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at intersections to improve visibility and reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Add a Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to increase the physical and psychological distance between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Construction Equipment Management
interventions.description: Implement stricter permitting and placement regulations for large dumpsters to ensure they do not obstruct sidewalks or critical sightlines.
